description: This file defines the PrepareBodyMiddleware class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for preparing HTTP requests with appropriate headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect before sending.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that prepares HTTP requests with necessary headers based on request content and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to modify the request with appropriate headers before passing it to the next handler.

methods.name: addExpectHeader
methods.description: Adds the Expect header to the request if conditions are met, based on request size, protocol, and options.
